label_policy.confidence_interpretation: Confidence describes support for this draft label, not a verified grouping truth.
label_policy.verification_rule: Each final OCR region is recorded independently. Shared detector bubble IDs, panel membership, conversation order, proximity, and crop overlap never establish a shared owner. Raw A02 fragment IDs are absent from this retained baseline.
label_policy.review_requirement: A coordinator visually reviewed the exact source and editor capture. Draft labels remain draft until source fragments and owner grouping evidence are available.
